decisions.description: A verdict per variant the reviewer decided. At most one favourite.

action.description: favorite: the one to take forward. keep: still on the shortlist. drop: set it aside.

duration_ms.description: The variant's timeline as the reviewer saw it, which each comment's start and end are fractions of.

comments.description: Changes asked for at a moment of the animation, or over a stretch of it, in time order.

start_ms.description: The moment, or the start of the stretch, in ms from the start of the variant's timeline.

end_ms.description: The end of the stretch, for a comment over a range. Absent for a moment.

start.description: start_ms as a fraction of duration_ms.

end.description: end_ms as a fraction of duration_ms.

frame.description: For a Lottie, the frame at start_ms, in the file's own numbering (ip is its first).

end_frame.description: For a Lottie, the frame at end_ms.

active.description: What was animating then. For CSS, each animation by its element and @keyframes name; for Lottie, each layer by name.

selector.description: The element, as a CSS selector within the variant's markup: .ring, .dots > i:nth-of-type(2).

from.description: How far through the @keyframes at start_ms: 0.4 is its 40% keyframe position.

to.description: How far through the @keyframes at end_ms, when the stretch ends in the same cycle.

compared_with.description: The variants that played beside it when the comment was written.
